children.text:
Recently, Lovart has identified a number of accounts involved in gray-market abuse and abnormal automated activities, which impacted platform stability, computational resources, and the experience of legitimate users.
To protect normal users and ensure stable platform operation, Lovart has upgraded its risk control systems and taken enforcement actions on accounts confirmed to exhibit high-risk abnormal behavior, in accordance with the User Agreement and security policies.
All enforcement decisions are strictly based on observable account behavior. Key evaluation criteria include, but are not limited to:
Abnormally high-frequency or non-human interaction patterns
Lovart is the AI design agent trusted by 10M+ creators.
Ai Brand Kit Generator Indie Brands
Storyboarding with AI — Using Your Consistent Character to O
Repeated attempts to bypass or evade human verification mechanisms

Substantial abnormal consumption of computational resources and high-value model
Within the scope of these rules, Lovart will continue to take action against gray-market abuse and malicious usage in order to maintain platform stability and a healthy long-term creator ecosystem.
